findings.title: Any concurrent success force-closes the breaker and zeroes the failure count, undoing an OPEN set by another thread
findings.evidence: after the guarded state check at lines 43-51 the lock is released and func runs; the completion block at 71-75 always writes CLOSED/failures=0/opened_at=None/probe_in_flight=False regardless of what state the breaker is in when the call returns, e.g. 'self._state = self.CLOSED'
findings.recommendation: Re-check under the lock before committing the success: only clear state/failures if the breaker is still in the state this call observed (e.g. record the generation/state at admission and only close if not superseded, and never overwrite OPEN or clear another thread's _probe_in_flight). Typical fix: on success, if probing, close only when self._state == HALF_OPEN and this call owns the probe; if not probing, reset _failures only when self._state == CLOSED.

findings.title: Probe outcome (success or failure) overwrites an operator reset() performed while the probe was in flight
findings.evidence: reset() clears _probe_in_flight at line 83 so a probe started before reset is no longer tracked, yet on failure the probe still executes 'self._state = self.OPEN' and re-opens the manually reset breaker; symmetrically a stale probe success clears the flag set by a newer probe
findings.recommendation: Track a monotonically increasing generation/epoch incremented by reset(), capture it at admission, and discard the probe result if the epoch changed before the completion block runs.

findings.title: BaseException during a half-open probe leaves the breaker stuck in HALF_OPEN so it can never trip to OPEN on repeated interruptions
findings.evidence: the handler entered via 'except BaseException:' only clears _probe_in_flight and leaves _state as HALF_OPEN, so a callable that repeatedly raises BaseException (e.g. cancellation, SystemExit) keeps the breaker in probe mode instead of returning to OPEN
findings.recommendation: On BaseException while probing, either restore OPEN (with a refreshed _opened_at) or document explicitly that cancellation must not count as a probe result; as written the state is left neither OPEN nor CLOSED with no path back to OPEN except a real Exception.

findings.title: New breaker state machine ships without tests for threshold, cooldown, single-probe and concurrency behaviour
findings.evidence: the module adds the full admission path 'def call(self, func, *args, **kwargs):' plus _refresh_locked/reset, and the change contains no test file and no test run
findings.recommendation: Add tests using an injected fake clock: open after N failures, reject while OPEN, OPEN->HALF_OPEN after reset_timeout, single probe (second caller rejected), probe failure re-opens with fresh opened_at, probe success closes, and a threaded test where a slow success overlaps a failure that opens the breaker.
